items.title: Awesome Ruby
items.content_text:
### Authorization

*   [Rabarber (⭐169)](https://github.com/brownboxdev/rabarber) - Simple role-based authorization for Rails with multi-tenancy support.

### Date and Time Processing

*   [Jekyll-Timeago (⭐154)](https://github.com/markets/jekyll-timeago) - A Ruby library to compute distance of dates in words, with localization support, alternative styles, CLI and Jekyll support.

### Geolocation

*   [IP2Location.io (⭐6)](https://github.com/ip2location/ip2location-io-ruby) - A Ruby SDK allows user to query for an enriched data set based on IP address and provides WHOIS lookup api that helps users to obtain domain information.

items.title: Awesome Godot
items.content_text:
### 2D / Godot 4

*   [99Managers Futsal Edition](https://codeberg.org/dulvui/99managers-futsal-edition) - A simple free/libre Futsal team-management game.

### 2D / Godot 3

*   [Pocket Broomball](https://codeberg.org/dulvui/pocket-broomball/) - The world's first broomball game, available for iOS, Android and html5.

### 3D / Godot 3

*   [Ball2Box](https://codeberg.org/dulvui/ball2box) - Shoot the ball into the box, available for iOS, Android and html5.
